About PC Part Performance

Hardware specifications, practical build tools, and clearly sourced explanations.

What we publish

PC Part Performance helps readers compare hardware, plan a PC, and understand game performance. Our Blog publishes researched explainers and practical guides. Articles credited to PC Part Performance are site-produced editorial content, not a claim of an independent laboratory or named expert review.

Evidence before claims

We link to manufacturer documentation and relevant original testing. We distinguish published specifications, estimates, company forecasts and our analysis. A product being listed does not mean we tested it, and a 3D illustration does not certify fit.

Dates and updates

Publication dates identify when an article appeared. Modification dates change when we substantively revise content. Market articles state the dates of their evidence; they are not continuously updated price feeds.

Buying information

Retailer links may be searches rather than exact listings. Missing or expired prices do not count toward a complete build total. Verify the exact variant, shipping, taxes and stock before purchasing.

Check our work

Each guide lists sources so you can review the evidence. Product pages link to their specification sources. See our data methodology and 3D coverage report for current limitations.
